title: Graph Traversal: BFS/DFS Family for NetworkX Parity
description: Implement mathematical_graph_traversal (mathematical/graph/traversal/rs/lib.rs), the NetworkX-parity BFS/DFS traversal family, generic over the frozen mathematical_graph::GraphView trait. Scope: bfs_edges, bfs_tree, bfs_layers, bfs_predecessors, bfs_successors, descendants_at_distance, generic_bfs_edges, dfs_edges, dfs_tree, dfs_preorder_nodes, dfs_postorder_nodes, dfs_labeled_edges, dfs_predecessors, dfs_successors, edge_bfs, edge_dfs, bfs_beam_edges. Iterative (no recursion), deterministic (BTreeMap/BTreeSet only), organized in #region blocks with tests covering chain/tree/cycle/disconnected/self-loop/multigraph cases. Sole owned file: mathematical/graph/traversal/rs/lib.rs.
